title: Pentagon
subtitle: A shield
description: A shield: a full-width flat top, vertical flanks down to the middle, and a straight taper to a point at the bottom. The point sits where an item has nothing, and the flat edge where a sprite's top goes.

The shape before it was point-up with a flat base -- the house orientation -- which put its point exactly where an item's own head wants to sit. Its mass is at the top, so the item's anchor sits three percent of the node above the middle rather than on the box's centre.
